pairs.registryProposal: scoreGeometry returns a pass/warn/fail verdict after substituting the topology facts the topology rules test. vacuous-by-evaluation tells the author to seed a counterexample per rule; it does not require a partial scorer's own verdict to name the rules that substitution made unfalsifiable. GATE_ONLY_CODES is a sibling export, not part of the verdict.
